title: Solvable Sokoban Without a Solver via Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.15958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deciding whether a Sokoban puzzle is solvable is PSPACE-complete (Culberson, 1997): solutions can be exponentially long and there is no short certificate to check. Solvability is also a fragile property, since even a single misplaced wall can silently render an entire puzzle unsolvable.   In this work, we show that a transformer-based discrete diffusion model trained purely on tile completion, with no access to solvers, rewards, or solvability labels, achieves a solvability rate of 77.4%, with 94.5% of the remaining failures rendered solvable by removing a single wall. In other words, a global, search-heavy property follows from a local training objective: trained only to fill in masked cells, the model inherits solvability it was never trained on. translated_title: 无需求解器的可解推箱子生成：基于扩散模型的方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：判断一个推箱子谜题是否可解是PSPACE完全的（Culberson，1997年）：解决方案可能呈指数级长度，且没有短证书可供验证。可解性也是一种脆弱的属性，因为即使一个放错位置的墙也可能悄无声息地使整个谜题无法解决。在这项工作中，我们展示了一种基于Transformer的离散扩散模型，仅通过瓷砖补全训练，不访问求解器、奖励或可解性标签，达到了77.4%的可解率，而剩余失败案例中的94.5%通过移除一堵墙即可变得可解。换言之，一个全局的、搜索密集的属性源于一个局部训练目标：仅训练于填充被遮蔽的单元格，该模型继承了从未被训练过的可解性。自回归模型分解为$p(c_k \mid c_1 \dots c_{k-1})$，意味着固定顺序，始终以前缀为条件。遮蔽扩散并非如此：它隐藏了随机子集的单元格。
tldr: 本文证明，仅通过局部瓷砖补全训练的离散扩散模型，无需求解器或可解性标签，即可生成77.4%可解的推箱子谜题，且多数失败可通过移除单墙修复，表明全局可解性可从局部目标中涌现。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a discrete diffusion model trained solely on local tile completion, without solvers or solvability labels, generates 77.4% solvable Sokoban puzzles, with most failures fixable by removing one wall, revealing that global solvability emerges from a local objective.
